from hermes_tools import write_file, terminal
src='''def transform(grid):
 h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[r[:] for r in grid]
 pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==2]
 r0=min(r for r,c in pts); c0=min(c for r,c in pts)
 shape={(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in pts}; H=max(r for r,c in shape)+1; W=max(c for r,c in shape)+1
 for a in range(h-H+1):
  for b in range(w-W+1):
   cells=[(a+dr,b+dc) for dr,dc in shape]
   if all(grid[r][c]==0 for r,c in cells):
    for r,c in cells: out[r][c]=2
 return out
'''
